y=ln(x+1) drawn as the parametric curve x=e^y−1 (smooth, 0.9pt, black instead of Desmos blue), on a light grey grid (minor 0.5, major 2) with no axis arrows, as in the crop. Three-circle Venn diagram (r≈97 px) with the circle positions, region numbers and set names in the crop's places. Set names are upright text in the house font, as on the paper. Rules 1,2,3,19.

Hand sketch of y=f(x) with the dashed line y=-x+1, redrawn level and in house style. Blank axes with ticks every 5 up to 25 on both axes, arrows at both ends of both axes, y label and 0 at the origin. Tick labels in the house font instead of the crop's sans-serif (rule 19).

Semi-ellipse y=2sqrt(1-x^2)+1 with closed endpoint dots at x=+-1 (height 1) and top at 3, at the sketch's (not-to-scale) proportions (rule 1). Ticks at x=+-1 and y=1, curve label kept, red marks dropped. Added an arrow and the label x on the x-axis. Low overlay is handwriting and scan offset.

D=8+2cos(4πt/25) plotted from the equation for 0≤t≤24 at the crop's scale (smooth, 90 samples, 0.9pt). Max at t=0 and 12.5, min at 6.25 and 18.75. Triangle with the vertices measured from the crop, labels 4.2 cm, 5.3 cm, 7.6 cm in the same positions, font set to about the crop's size.
